title: Band Uplift Added for the Car a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Trip Is On
content:
A band uplift is added for the value of the car the trip is on when an additional driver is taken onto a
Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election. Which uplift applies is read from the daily rate locked in on the trip,
carried on the Keyturn Trip Booking.

- Where the daily rate locked in on the trip reaches 140.00 USD, an uplift of 14.00 USD is added.
- Where the daily rate locked in on the trip reaches 100.00 USD but not 140.00 USD, an uplift of 9.00 USD is
  added.
- Where it reaches neither figure, an uplift of 0.00 USD is added.

## Both sides of the two bands

| Daily rate locked in on the trip | Band uplift added |
|---|---|
| 139.99 USD | 9.00 USD |
| 140.00 USD | 14.00 USD |
| 99.99 USD | 0.00 USD |
| 100.00 USD | 9.00 USD |

A band is reached at its own figure: a daily rate of exactly 140.00 USD reaches the upper band and carries
14.00 USD, and a daily rate of exactly 100.00 USD reaches the lower band and carries 9.00 USD. A cent below
either figure the trip falls into the band beneath.

## Worked on hypothetical trips

A trip whose locked-in daily rate is 165.00 USD carries a band uplift of 14.00 USD, which is added to the
figure worked out for the additional driver. A trip at 112.50 USD a day carries 9.00 USD. A trip at 62.00 USD a
day carries nothing on this account, the uplift standing at 0.00 USD. The uplift is one flat amount added to
the fee worked out for that driver, and it does not vary with how many days the election covers.
